title: The Frequency Google map gets a full calm style in light and dark, gradient cluster badges that never overlap, one area badge for events sharing a town centre, a clean popup card and a Close map pill clear of the controls

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-14, the installed Android app: the map on the App looks like trash; the google map needs a full Frequency styling; the event popup card looks bad in mobile dark mode.

detail: Basemap: lib/maps/basemap-look.ts FREQUENCY_BASEMAP is one full custom Google style in two modes from the SCAN-907 export values (literal, since the canvas token now resolves only in light mode): light on the cool canvas #F4F6F7 with a soft aqua sea, faint seaglass parks, roads a breath darker than the land with no strokes (arterials and highways a little stronger, thinner weights), lavender-grey labels on a canvas halo; dark on near-black blue land with deep teal water, dim roads and soft light labels. Every business POI, attraction and transit line is hidden, terrain is flat, parcels and neighbourhood labels are off and boundaries are faint. Dark is picked by html.dark or a dark band (the Stage), and both engines swap live when the mode flips (watchColorMode). maplibreBasemapPaint mirrors it, adds the arterial step and hides POI labels. Clusters: under Frequency both engines draw a round badge in the export deep sweep (sky, aqua, seaglass; lib/maps/pin-kinds.ts FREQUENCY_CLUSTER) with a white ring and a white bold count with a soft shadow, sized in three steps (under 10, under 50, above; clusterStepDiameterPx); Google draws it as an SVG image with the count as the marker label. Grouping uses a wider 72px radius and a spacing pass that merges badges whose discs would sit closer than 6px, so a 99+ no longer sits on a 6+. Co-located pins: pins on one exact coordinate (a city-centre fallback, about 93 Encinitas events) travel as one unit and become one general area badge that never splits; tapping it opens a list card, N events around Encinitas, linking each event (MapPin.place carries the town). Pins with a location of their own never move, and the same holds with clustering off. Popup card: under Frequency Google's InfoWindow chrome is stripped (no padding, no scroll clipping, no header band, no tail), the cover runs edge to edge at the top with the close button as a round chip over it, and title, meta and link take the kit's surface and text tokens so it reads in light and dark; the MapLibre popup matches. Full-screen map: the Close map pill moves top left and Google shows only zoom buttons pinned bottom right, with map type, Street View, fullscreen and rotate off. DAWN is unchanged (everything gates on the --fq tokens at the map, as SCAN-904 did); the viewport-gated lazy load is kept.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=p=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const bad=[];const b=r('lib/maps/basemap-look.ts'),c=r('lib/maps/cluster.ts'),g=r('components/maps/google-canvas.tsx'),m=r('components/maps/maplibre-canvas.tsx'),s=r('components/maps/map-canvas.tsx'),css=r('app/themes/frequency/members-ui.css');if(!b.includes('export const FREQUENCY_BASEMAP')||!/dark: \\{\\s*dark: true/.test(b))bad.push('no full Frequency Google style in light and dark');if(!b.includes('export function watchColorMode')||!g.includes('watchColorMode('))bad.push('the Google map does not follow light and dark');if(!c.includes('coLocated')||!c.includes('export function clusterStepDiameterPx')||!c.includes('minSpacingPx'))bad.push('co-located pins and badge spacing are not handled');if(!g.includes('frequencyBadgeSvg(')||!m.includes('buildFrequencyBadge('))bad.push('clusters are not the gradient badge on both engines');if(!g.includes('buildAreaPopupContent(')||!m.includes('buildAreaPopupContent('))bad.push('a general area does not open its list');if(!g.includes('mapTypeControl: false')||!g.includes('ControlPosition.RIGHT_BOTTOM'))bad.push('Google controls are not placed clear of Close map');if(!s.includes('fq-map-close')||!css.includes('.fq-map-close{right:auto'))bad.push('the Close map pill still sits top right under Frequency');if(!css.includes('.gm-style-iw-chr')||!css.includes('.fqm-card__cover'))bad.push('the map card keeps Google InfoWindow chrome');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-918: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
